preregistration: this file, committed before any generation (record-first). Owner answers 18-Oct-2026, in-session: 'Revise and re measure'; design 'held-out + same tasks, $30 cap'.
hypothesis: Neutral (ADR 0059): for each model, appending REVISION 1 of the control-narratives skill body to the system prompt may raise, lower, or leave unchanged the graded fraction of expectations met, versus the same model with no skill. A null, a harmful result, or a model-dependent result are equally valid recorded outcomes.
revision: revision 1 (commit c2040a5) changes four places in SKILL.md: when no instrument index, cause-and-effect chart, alarm database or setpoint list was given, the reply writes the needed rows or provisional values itself; 'a reference or a TBD is not a specification'; one checklist line amended, one added. Written by the session that read the first run's judge reasons for ids 1-16, so those ids are TUNED-ON.

arms.without: claude -p --model <M> --effort medium, isolation flags (--tools "", --disable-slash-commands, --strict-mcp-config, shared deny list), empty CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, cwd outside the checkout; hermetic_driver.NEUTRAL_FRAME + task text on stdin; CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=32000
arms.with: without + --append-system-prompt = treatments/control-narratives.txt (live SKILL.md body at source_sha, frontmatter stripped)

effort: medium for both models, as the 12-Oct batches
instrument: scripts copied from 2026-10-18-control-narratives-vs-bare at its committed state; changes: NEW_FROM_ID=17 (only held-out ids prescreened; ids 1-16 carry that run's selection), no pilot (per-cell estimates below come from that run's grid actuals), held-out cells ordered first with a pre-registered fallback, verdicts split by eval set. aggregate.py run offline on the first run's graded grid reproduces its verdicts exactly under tuned_on.

evals.tuned_on: ids 1-16, byte-identical in content to the first run's frozen set
evals.held_out: ids 17-32, authored after revision 1 was committed by a fresh lane told to read no file on disk and use no web search, given only the skill's one-line public description, same instructions as ids 1-16 plus a wider equipment list. Added verbatim, unedited.

prescreen.rule: 1 bare rep per held-out eval per model, graded before any with-arm cell; bare fraction-met >= 0.85 dropped for that model only; errored prescreen kept (unscreened). ids 1-16 use the first run's prescreen selection: opus 6 survivors, sonnet 9.
prescreen.g_floor: a model with fewer than 8 surviving evals still runs, labelled DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY: it may mark the claim UNDERPOWERED, never back a KEEP (ADR 0095 decision 4)

grid: surviving evals x {with, without} x 2 models x 2 reps, fresh: no first-run cell is reused. Fallback: if the cost gate refuses the full grid, the tuned-on cells are dropped and the held-out primary runs alone (recorded as a deviation-free pre-registered branch).
judging: Claude Opus 5.5 judge, isolated identically, rubric.skill_grade_prompt per cell. Same family as the generators: every verdict here is FRAME-UNCHECKED (ADR 0093) and may not be promoted to a README KEEP until a cross-family judge grades the same committed cells (`grade.py --judges grok`) and agrees. No cross-family CLI is installed in this container.
metrics: per model and eval set: benchstats.keep_verdict of the eval-clustered (with - without) fraction-met delta, practical bar 0, plus mde80.
primary: the HELD-OUT verdict per model (2 intervals).
secondary: the TUNED-ON verdict per model (expected optimistic: revision 1 was written against these tasks); the held-out delta pooled over both models' (model, eval) clusters.
decision_rule: Revision 1 replaces the measured version only if the pooled held-out delta is not HARMFUL (CI upper bound > 0); if it is HARMFUL, revert to the 18-Oct text and recommend pulling the skill. A README KEEP needs a per-model held-out KEEP at G>=8 AND a cross-family judge agreeing; otherwise the README records the direction only.
power: at the repo's measured spread 0.24, G=8 reliably calls about 0.30 and G=10 about 0.25 (pre-registration.md sizing table); a smaller true effect will likely read INCONCLUSIVE.
multiplicity: 2 primary intervals at 95% each, no correction: about 0.1 false calls expected under a null.

cost.ceiling_basis: owner's $30 cap for this re-measure, 18-Oct (separate from the first run's $30)
